title: Round record contract
description: One JSON line per round of the method, appended to state/round-record.jsonl. The rubric_hash ties the round to the frozen sha256 of the 'Rubric' section the verdict applied to; the verdict enum mirrors the mechanical rule of that section (rejected, accepted, accepted with conditions); rubric_author names who wrote that rubric.

method_version.description: Semantic version of the method this round ran under.

model.description: The executor of the role, by family (a letter kept stable across the material, e.g. 'family A') and effort, never by model identifier: a product identifier changes and leaks the provider, and the family is what the rule of independence uses. The map from letter to identifier stays with the owner, outside the material. A route or alias is not a family: two executors differ when what their names map to differs. Since v0.5.0 a reviewer is described by its relation to the producer ('reviewer, same family as the producer' or 'reviewer, another family'), never as 'independent' when the family is the same; the lines written before are never rewritten.

summary.description: What the round did, one line.

rubric_author.description: Who wrote the rubric the round applies: a role name, or 'producer', 'reviewer side' or 'owner'. Step 8 of the recipe gives the rubric to the owner and the reviewing side; a rubric written by the producer is recorded as such, never left implicit.
